title: R2 and Durable Objects availability issues

timeline.body: Customers using R2 and Durable Objects in Eastern North America may be experiencing intermittent errors and failed requests. We are investigating the cause and working to confirm that service availability has stabilized. We will provide updates as more information becomes available.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
